items.title: Copper jumps to its highest level ever. What the metal is telling us
items.summary: Copper surged to a record high Thursday, but the latest rally comes against a more mixed growth backdrop, making the once-reliable gauge of economic health, "Dr. Copper," harder to read.

items.title: United Wholesale Mortgage plunges 35% after suspending dividend and raising capital
items.summary: Shares in UWM Holdings , parent of United Wholesale Mortgage, plunged 35% on Thursday after the biggest U.S. mortgage lender suspended its dividend and raised fresh capital.

items.title: Traders on Kalshi now think it's likely that the S&P 500 will hit 8,000 in 2026
items.summary: The S&P 500 ended its more than 5.5% four-day rally on Wednesday, but the broad index's surge to new records is recalibrating prediction market traders' outlook for how high it can go.

items.title: Bank of America spends $250 million a year on GLP-1 drugs for its employees, CEO says
items.summary: Bank of America spends more than $250 million a year covering GLP-1 weight loss drugs for its employees, CEO Brian Moynihan told CNBC on Wednesday, saying the rapidly rising cost is a worthwhile investment in his workforce.

items.title: The July jobs numbers are due out Friday. Here's what to expect
items.summary: Job growth isn't expected to show much improvement in July, with payrolls and the unemployment rate likely holding relatively steady and economists looking through the headline numbers for further clues about labor market health.
